vignette: A child at a recall visit has a small noncavitated interproximal lesion on a permanent premolar. The tooth is asymptomatic and the surface is intact. The clinician wants a minimally invasive plan that reduces the chance of progression.
stem: Which management is most appropriate for this lesion?

options.text: Immediate conventional restoration, because placing a restoration stops the caries process
Interim therapeutic restoration for caries control
Restoration of the lesion, because every caries lesion needs to be restored
